creator: dgubert
title: TailorKey Zero v4.2c Homerow - Custom symbols v0.4
notes:
Homerow variant: the bilateral layers and the Typing layer are removed. The home-row mods use one plain hold-tap (&HRM), with the kanata timings: tap-time 150, hold-time 200. The unused AutoShift, Caps Word and mod-tab chord behaviors are removed.

This is NOT the original

Change log v0.4:
- Homerow: disable Autoshift
- Cursor: Better maps 
- Lower: map Q to "Super + q" - close windows in i3
- Lower: numpad numbers on right hand
- Lower: miscellaneous combo changes
- __Symbol__: try a &Shift_Combo macro to avoid intermittent lower case symbols
- __Symbol__: relocate several symbols

Change log v0.3:
- Lower: number row on LH changed to switch workspaces on i3 (LGUI + number)

🧿TKZ42bBIL: https://sites.google.com/view/keyboards/glove80_tailorkey
This is an advanced example layout demonstrating the use of macros, combos, hold taps and other advanced features to support:
- Advanced HRM with Bilateral Combinations Enforcement (Sunaku)
- Autoshift
- Symbol, Cursor and Gaming Layers
- Advanced Mouse Emulation
- Combo keys

This layout (TailorKey Zero) is developed by @moosy. Further information is available on https://sites.google.com/view/keyboards/glove80_tailorkey
TailorKey is inspired by the fully featured Glorious Engrammer, developed by @sunaku. Please see https://github.com/sunaku/glove80-keymaps/releases for the Glorious Engrammer layout.

TIP: Want to use only a part of this layout (like Home-row mods or Autoshift)? Just copy that specific layer, and the associated macros and hold-tap actions will come along automatically. 
See how it's done here:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m72eTAEUWho
